# `fjc_judges`

**FJC Article III judges**

FJC Article III judges with exact retained FJC source evidence.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Each selected complete FJC Article III flat export retains its native judge population and repeated service groups, including listed historical courts and recess appointees. Acquisition time identifies an observation, not a frozen publisher revision. Other federal judges and vacancy histories are outside this export. Earlier observations survive only when selected together or retained in prior generations. Missing later rows do not prove deletion; cross-source identities remain unresolved. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `fjc_judges.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Exact admitted source-release digest; include it in every join to keep observations separate. |
| `nid` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Node ID, the native judge identifier; distinct from legacy jid and external judge IDs. |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Positional source-record identity in the admitted release. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original URL, response SHA-256, byte size, acquisition time, CSV record number and exact byte span. Byte offsets are zero based; CSV record numbers include the header. |
| `jid_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal legacy FJC Judge Identification Number; preserve blank or publisher-supplied values without substituting nid. |
| `last_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Last Name, without name matching. |
| `first_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC First Name. |
| `middle_name_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Middle Name, including whitespace. |
| `suffix_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Suffix, including whitespace. |
| `gender_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher Gender; no analytical recoding. |
| `race_or_ethnicity_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher Race or Ethnicity; subjective historical and self-reported categories remain unchanged. |
| `birth_month_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Birth Month; preserve blanks and source precision without constructing a complete date. |
| `birth_day_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Birth Day; preserve blanks and source precision without constructing a complete date. |
| `birth_year_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Birth Year; preserve blanks and source precision without constructing a complete date. |
| `death_month_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Death Month; preserve blanks and source precision without constructing a complete date. |
| `death_day_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Death Day; preserve blanks and source precision without constructing a complete date. |
| `death_year_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC Death Year; preserve blanks and source precision without constructing a complete date. |
| `biography_url` | `VARCHAR` | FJC biography link formed from the publisher-documented nid route. |
| `external_judge_id` | `VARCHAR` | NULL until separately evidenced cross-source identity resolution. |
| `external_identity_status` | `VARCHAR` | unresolved; this build performs no cross-source person or court matching. |
| `raw_fields_json` | `VARCHAR` | Every literal source column, including demographics, all service groups, education, professional career, other service, unsuccessful nominations and unknown extensions. Empty strings and whitespace survive. |
